ysm_enhancements.configuration.title: YSM Enhancements
ysm_enhancements.configuration.shortcutC: Respect lock shortcut modifiers and context
ysm_enhancements.configuration.booleanVa: Treat negative nonzero values as checked
ysm_enhancements.configuration.buttonPan: Uses the model author's menu and control definitions. Disabling this restores the original wheel while keeping other fixes independent.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.inputRese: Clears stale held inputs on focus loss, GUI opening and physical release.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.shortcutC: The animation-lock shortcut respects its modifier and in-game context.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.mouseShor: Allows YSM shortcuts bound to mouse buttons using the existing modifier and action logic.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.clippedCo: Rejects clicks outside the original wheel's visible control viewport.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.scrollArr: Updates the original wheel's arrows after scrolling and asynchronous control loading.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.numericVa: Reads values such as 1e-5 correctly. Does not guess model-specific rendering defaults.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.scaleDefa: For zero values outside the slider range, read explicit zero-fallback constants in model scale expressions. Opening the panel changes only the displayed value, never model variables. Ambiguous cases retain the original display.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.booleanVa: Displays negative nonzero variables as checked. The model author determines what checking the option does.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.searchCar: Preserves the caret, selection and text viewport when rebuilding model search results.
ysm_enhancements.configuration.staleCall: Rejects delayed callbacks from a previous screen generation after rebuild or close.
